Subject: Identity hardening & SSO/SCIM rollout — ZenithBank onboarding

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the quick handoff. As discussed on the account call, Redwood's onboarding for enterprise access will focus on four areas we want to align on before the kickoff: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists/networking, and service account governance (naming/rotation/audit).

Attached is a lightweight checklist we use to capture the configuration surface and owners: sso_scim_checklist.xlsx. Quick asks to help us prepare the technical kickoff (we can cover any of these on the call):

- IdP details: vendor (PingFederate/OIDC/Okta), SP metadata endpoint, and cert/key rotation cadence.
- SCIM: do you provision groups or users only? Any specific attribute mappings beyond email/name (e.g., cost_center, department)?
- IP allowlist: do you prefer we publish a set of outbound IP ranges or allowlist Redwood per project? If you have a current CIDR list, please share.
- Service accounts: recommended naming pattern and whether the accounts need HSM-backed keys / stricter key rotation.

Proposed timeline: internal prep this week, kickoff technical workshop Wed 2027-06-23, configuration window next week, smoke-test by 2027-07-01. If that works, please confirm attendees for the kickoff and any required calendar invites.

Attachments: sso_scim_checklist.xlsx, ip-allowlist-template.csv

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Monica Patel

Subject: Re: Identity hardening & SSO/SCIM rollout — ZenithBank onboarding

Hi Monica —

Thanks — good summary. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff: 

- IdP: We run PingFederate for corporate SSO. We can share the metadata URL but cert rotation is handled by our platform team quarterly. We will need Redwood to support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated login with EntityIDs and ACS endpoints documented.
- SCIM: We plan to provision groups only at first (security groups mapped to application roles). We will need group -> role mapping (we can provide the desired mapping table).
- IP allowlist: attaching our current outbound firewall egress list (zenith-current-ip-list.csv). For high-security environments we prefer inbound allowlisting to specific service IPs rather than open CIDR ranges.
- Service accounts: our policy requires service accounts to be audited and rotated every 90 days. We also need the service account usage logged to a central SIEM (Splunk).

Two asks: please include a short note on how Redwood exposes audit logs for authentication and provisioning events, and whether you support SCIM patch operations vs full replaces (we prefer PATCH).

I looped in Rahul (Infosec) for the security constraints — he may add a couple items. We'll aim for the workshop on Wed 2027-06-23 but Rahul will confirm.

Regards,
Aisha Banerjee
Senior Manager, Identity & Access
ZenithBank
aisha.banerjee@zenithbank.com

Attachment: zenith-current-ip-list.csv

Subject: RE: Identity hardening & SSO/SCIM rollout — ZenithBank onboarding

Aisha — thanks for the details. Quick technical plan below (we'll walk through this on Wed):

SAML / SSO (SP configuration)
- Redwood will publish SP metadata at https://redwood.com/saml/sp/zenithbank/metadata (we'll provide an explicit ACS URL for your PingFederate config).
- Support for SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; cert rotation supported via a signed XML keydescriptor with rollover window.
- Token/session lifetimes: default session cookie 8h, configurable per-tenant (we can shorten to 1h for sensitive apps).

SCIM provisioning
- We support SCIM 2.0 with PATCH semantics and incremental sync (preferred).
- Group provisioning: we'll map SCIM groups to Redwood roles; please send the group->role CSV and we will pre-seed mappings in a staging org.
- Attribute mappings: we can include cost_center and department as claim mappings; we will coordinate attribute contract during the workshop.

Service accounts & audit
- Recommended naming: redwood-sa-<env>-<purpose>-<shortid>. We rotate keys automatically every 90 days and emit key rotation events to our audit stream.
- Audit logs: authentication events, SCIM provisioning events (create/update/patch/delete), and service-account token usage are available via our event streaming endpoint and can be pushed to Splunk via HTTPS ingestion or pulled from our log export. We will share a sample Splunk HEC config.

IP allowlist / networking
- We can provide a project-scoped set of static egress IPs. For inbound allowlisting we recommend minimal CIDRs per environment. Template attached: ip-allowlist-template.csv.

Proposed kickoff agenda (Wed 2027-06-23, 10:00-11:00 PST):
1) Introductions & owners (5m)
2) SAML metadata & cert exchange (15m)
3) SCIM mappings and group sync plan (15m)
4) Service account policy & rotation/audit (10m)
5) IP allowlist and networking handoff (10m)
6) Timeline, test plan, and go/no-go criteria (5m)

Attachments: redwood-internal-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook snippets), ip-allowlist-template.csv

If that agenda looks good I'll post the Teams invite and we'll include a short pre-read (the checklist).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
